post.description: Public Query API. Three modes: `vector` (embedding similarity; accepts optional `target: 'blocks' | 'edges'`, default `blocks`), `graph` (typed-link traversal from `seed_block_id`), and `hybrid` (vector seed + one-hop graph expansion). `semantic` is accepted as a backward-compat alias for `vector`. The legacy `fulltext` and `edge_semantic` modes were removed in phase-2 (#104); requests using them receive 400. The tsvector index on `blocks.tsv` and the `links.edge_embedding` column remain as internal signals — `target: 'edges'` exposes the edge-embedding ranking that the retired `edge_semantic` mode used to surface.

mode.description: Public modes: `vector`, `graph`, `hybrid`. `semantic` is accepted as a backward-compat alias for `vector`.

target.description: Vector-mode target embedding space. `blocks` ranks `blocks.embedding`; `edges` ranks `links.edge_embedding`.

max_hops.description: Graph mode only; maximum traversal depth.

rel_types.description: Graph mode only; restrict traversal to these `rel_type` values.

src_text.description: Vector-edges mode only; structured-triple probe source text.

dst_text.description: Vector-edges mode only; structured-triple probe destination text.

rel_hint.description: Vector-edges mode only; optional rel_type hint for the structured-triple probe.

layers.description: Graph + hybrid + vector(edges); restrict by link layer.

400.description: Invalid request — including deprecated mode names (`fulltext`, `edge_semantic`).
